title: Run candidate canaries on the dev instance
goal: Compare a candidate on ~/.susi-dev and ports 9190-9194 using an isolated evaluation workload; crossing a declared regression limit stops the trial without replacing the installed release. Deps (vectors): VC-201-006, VC-201-014, VC-201-015. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_017_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
